notes.content:
Fixed:
- Unable to reload weapons by gamepad.
- Problem with squirter in the data room becoming invincible after load saved game.
- Problem with the animation of the Reaper's Judgement
- Rolling action will be blocked by the side wall.
- The issue that the zombies before taking a shower may be triggered earlier.
- Problem with photos being completely black in medium quality

A little surprise:
- Added Tactical Leg Holster

The Chinese New Year costume pack has been released. It can be obtained in the following ways:
[list]
[*] https://afdian.net/a/thekillingantidote
[*] https://patreon.com/TheKillingAntidote
[/list]

[list]
[*] Resolved the bug of climbing out of ventilation ducts.
[*] Adjusted the damage detection of melee weapon normal attacks.
[*] Added a "Reset Keys Settings" button, which can be used to resolve issues with view control and joystick control.
[*] Problems with weepers not getting up when attacked from far away
[*] Devourer chase scene has been lowered a little bit of difficulty
[/list]

- Abandoned Hangar
  = Removed the storage box near the starting point
  = Problem with occasional invalid result
  = Added respawn points. Find and activate respawn points, so that protagonist can respawn at the last activated respawn point after death.

[list]
[*] When attacked while looking in the mirror, unable to return to normal game state.
[*] Turn off character control buttons when playing a cutscene
[*] Restore stamina at the end of a cutscene
[*] Throwing melee weapons may go through walls
[*] Characters may get stuck in the middle of ventilation ducts
[*] Hitting a zombie's limbs no longer causes it to stun
[*] In Challenge Mode, dodging when the upgrade menu appears caused the options to disappear
[*] Reduced stamina consumption in Easy Mode
[*] Protagonist has double health in easy mode
[*] Some minor issues with the interface logic
[/list]

We are working on new content, stay tuned for 0.4.9.
Chinese New Year is coming soon, we are working on Chinese clothing packs, such as cheongsam.

[list]
[*] https://afdian.net/a/thekillingantidote
[*] https://www.patreon.com/TheKillingAntidote
[/list]

- Fixed a bunch of bugs in UI
- Fixed some bugs about achievements and leaderboards
- Added 5 interesting achievements
- Fixed some bugs in story mode

Bugs fixed:

- Problem with slow character turnaround
- Problem with computer not being able to exit
- Problem that the death view is too close
- Problem that hangar challenges always indicate invalid results
